description:
The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already open in JASP. This dataset (Field, 2013) contains data from 103 students on Exam performance (%), Anxiety level, Revision time, and Gender. Your goal is to perform a One-Way MANOVA to test for gender differences in both Exam performance and Anxiety simultaneously.

Instructions:
1. Navigate to the ANOVA module and select 'MANOVA'.
2. Set 'Exam' and 'Anxiety' as the Dependent Variables.
3. Set 'Gender' as the Fixed Factor.
4. Under 'Additional Options', enable 'Descriptive statistics'.
5. Once the analysis is generated in the results panel, save the JASP file as 'ExamAnxiety_MANOVA.jasp' in the '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/' folder.
